name: Side-Scan Sonar
desc: A towed side-scan sonar record unrolling forever: two acoustic swaths either side of the black water-column gap, sand-ripple fields shading bright on the slopes that face the fish, and boulders and wrecks throwing long black acoustic shadows away from nadir while range scales and fix marks scroll down the paper.

density.doc: how many boulders and wrecks litter the bottom

speed.doc: tow speed — how fast the record scrolls

nadir.doc: width of the water-column gap down the middle

grain.doc: Rayleigh speckle — the characteristic sonar grain

hue.doc: record hue (rotates the colour map; 28 = copper anchor)

style.doc: aesthetic: classic copper paper record / grayscale hydrographic survey / cold blue-white / ironbow thermal / high-contrast printed duotone plate

act.doc: multi-minute programme: open bottom / a debris field of wrecks and boulders / a pipeline running along-track with free spans
